{{Quote|My ship carries command codes that override the automatic defense systems in the field. The codes must be input manually at the right time. Only I know when to input the codes. At the heart of the field is ''Annamar''&mdash;a planetoid with a breathable atmosphere.|[[Luca/Legends|Luca]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="SWA" />}}
The '''Annamar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Annamar asteroid field]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planetoid]] [[Annamar]].<ref name="SWA" />
